say:3:1211126001:0.text: My old man used to tell me stories every time he came back from the sea...
say:3:1211126001:0.source_cn: ……以前，老爹每次出海回来，都会给我讲故事。

say:4:1211126002:0.text: In those stories, he'd fend off pirates and find countless treasures.
say:4:1211126002:0.source_cn: 在故事里，他击退了大海盗，获得了无数神奇的宝藏。

say:5:1211126003:0.text: They were just made-up lies to make me happy, but I believed them all.
say:5:1211126003:0.source_cn: 根本就是为了哄我随口胡编的谎话，我却全都信了。

say:6:1211126004:0.text: My old man had only one decent vest... He couldn't even afford a new compass, but he'd still sail out in storms...
say:6:1211126004:0.source_cn: 那家伙，明明只有一件还算像样的马甲……连个新的罗盘都舍...

say:7:1211126005:0.text: Why are you talking about your father all of a sudden?
say:7:1211126005:0.source_cn: 怎么突然讲起你父亲的事了？

say:8:1211126006:0.text: Because... this is the compass he used.
say:8:1211126006:0.source_cn: 因为……这是我老爹当年用过的罗盘，是他的护身符。

say:9:1211126007:0.text: Ah, so it was your father's, and it became your keepsake.
say:9:1211126007:0.source_cn: 哎？竟然是你父亲的……遗物？

say:10:1211126008:0.text: Shh—don't say that! Chippy! You'll make him sad.
say:10:1211126008:0.source_cn: 嘘——笨蛋满满！别说这些，他会伤心的。

say:12:1211126009:0.text: It's okay. This was his lucky charm, but now it's mine.
say:12:1211126009:0.source_cn: 也没什么好忌讳的。这本来是他的护身符，却成了他的遗物。

say:13:1211126010:0.text: The weather was awful the day he left. I had a bad feeling, so I cried and begged him to stay.
say:13:1211126010:0.source_cn: 他离开我的那天，天气很不好。或许是直觉，我哭闹着不让他走。

say:14:1211126011:0.text: He took out this compass and told me that he had to go on a special mission.
say:14:1211126011:0.source_cn: 他把这个罗盘拿出来，告诉我，伟大的船长要去执行任务了。

say:15:1211126012:0.text: As his first mate, my mission was to stay home and wait for his return. He promised to give me his compass when he came back.
say:15:1211126012:0.source_cn: 作为他的大副，我要执行的任务就是乖乖在家待着。等到他回...

say:16:1211126013:0.text: And I would take his name and become the great Captain Sinbad.
say:16:1211126013:0.source_cn: 到那时，我就会继承他的名号，成为伟大的——辛巴达船长。

say:18:1211126014:0.text: But he never came back... His ship, his compass, and him... all vanished forever in the sea.
say:18:1211126014:0.source_cn: 但是他再也没有回来。\n他的船，他的罗盘，他的身影，都...

say:19:1211126015:0.text: That filthy sea rat! He'd throw away anything for his dreams, even me!
say:19:1211126015:0.source_cn: 差劲的家伙！为了梦想， 他什么都能抛下！包括我！

say:29:1211126021:0.source_cn: 他陨落后，大多数的力量都已经归还世界，少许力量如浮萍般...

say:30:1211126022:0.source_cn: 罗盘上竟然有特勒米琉斯的力量？我能使用吗？

say:33:1211126025:0.source_cn: 作为一块罗盘，至少，它会为你指引方向吧。

say:34:1211126026:0.text: Right... My old man used to tell me that the compass would lead me wherever I wanted to go.
say:34:1211126026:0.source_cn: 是啊……老爹曾经说过，只要是我想去的地方，罗盘就会为我引路。
